subject: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
oracle: D6 primary, per D10/D12/D13: surface-form string at a word boundary

intervention.operator: K6 dose: h' = h - lambda * (v_hat^T h) v_hat, per position
intervention.layers: every frozen-band layer, each using its own J_l

floor_prediction.rule: D30.3: the margin is a PREDICTION, not a guarantee — validation runs on calibration frames while the floor decides on eval frames, and M0's per-text lesson forbids assuming paraphrases contribute evenly. Recorded before any eval spend.

corpus.dataset: wikitext-103-raw-v1 train, streamed in order, stripped length >= 600
corpus.position_mask: NONE — D30.1: the mask is a probe-scoring convention, not an NLL one

disjointness.rule: dim-stage/s3_selectivity.py:621-628 — the first 100 qualifying streamed records equal the fit corpus, so records 101-200 are disjoint from the lens fit

note: D30's four clauses. The clean arm is lambda = 0 with hooks installed and the edit path exact-return (D27/D28), except the WikiText clean arm which is one unedited, secret-independent forward per record (D30.1). No byte-check against M0: D28 scopes the identity arm to the T4 eval cells and these prompts have no M0 counterpart.

tolerance.note: the realized tolerance the within-CI form bought at this scale, printed where the verdict is read (PR #8, review F5)

paired_companion.note: secret-clustered (D1: records repeat across secrets), width governed by the clusters not the differences (PR #8, review F14). Deliberately decides nothing: a paired test answers detectability, the clause's estimand is effect size against a pre-registered yardstick.

collapse.note: the T4 population's collapse conjunct lives in m2-ablation-<scale>.json; gates/g3.py reads all three (D30.4).
